sources.claim: The ticket requires adding Inbound, conditional-if, conditional-loop, and subtest step types to blazemeter_apitest_steps.
The ticket requires modifying/updating an existing test step.
The ticket requires changing test step order.
The selected design adds per-step-type builders mirroring add_request_step/add_pause_step.
update_step reads the current step, merges updates, and PUTs to /steps/{step_id}.
reorder_steps PUTs a caller-supplied template_order list to /steps.
The TestStep model is extended with inbound and subtest fields to avoid dropping response data.
add_pause_step is the existing builder analog that POSTs a flat step_type body via api_request.
_put_step PUTs a full step dict to /steps/{step_id} via api_request.
TestStep currently lacks inbound (token/isDynamicUrl) and several subtest fields, which Pydantic drops by default.
format_steps round-trips each API step dict through TestStep.model_dump without aggregation.
The radar input wire key for the conditional-if step is 'condition' (not 'conditional'); the parser auto-appends the end block.
The subtest radar input requires test_uuid, trigger_token, environment_uuid, bucket_key, use_parent_environment; lazy validation matches the request-step precedent.
The tool reads no runtime/cache/db/queue data whose lifecycle could invalidate a read.
T003 implements add_inbound_step in step_manager.py.
T007 implements update_step in step_manager.py.
T008 implements reorder_steps in step_manager.py.
T011 extends the TestStep model with inbound and subtest fields.
test_add_inbound_step through test_add_subtest_step cover AC-1 add actions.
test_update_step covers AC-2 modify.
test_reorder_steps covers AC-3 reorder.
The Constitution Check passes with no principle violations; the architecture reuses the existing single-api_request adapter pattern.
